items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn() class merge helper used by ARCTIS registry components.

items.name: glow-button
items.title: Glow Button
items.description: A squared button with a colored halo that blooms on hover and keyboard focus.
items.docs: Import from @/components/ui/glow-button. The halo is CSS-only and respects reduced motion.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A bordered surface with a radial spotlight that follows the pointer. Pointer tracking uses CSS variables, so moving the mouse never re-renders React.
items.docs: Import from @/components/ui/spotlight-card. Move the pointer over the card to see the radial highlight.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text Shimmer
items.description: A looping gradient sweep clipped to the text. Motion is disabled automatically when the visitor prefers reduced motion.
items.docs: Import from @/components/ui/text-shimmer. The keyframes are installed into your global CSS.

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: Three drifting color layers behind a hairline grid. A section-scale backdrop that stays out of the accessibility tree.
items.docs: Import from @/components/ui/aurora-background. The keyframes are installed into your global CSS.
